Embedded Software Engineer Intern

Join the flight software team building avionics for our next-generation
vehicle. You will write firmware that runs on real hardware and flies.

What you'll work on
- Develop embedded C/C++ software for real-time flight systems
- Implement and debug hardware drivers (SPI, I2C, UART) for sensors
- Work with RTOS task scheduling and interrupt handling
- Bench-test firmware against hardware-in-the-loop setups

Basic qualifications
- Pursuing a BS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or similar
- Strong C and C++ programming skills
- Understanding of operating systems, concurrency, and memory management
- Experience reading sensor datasheets and debugging on hardware

Preferred
- Experience with microcontrollers (STM32 or similar)
- Familiarity with kernel-level or low-level systems programming
- Experience with Linux and Git
